headline: House passes disability work expansion 232-188 as Senate readies weekend hammer on intelligence director

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate confirmed two judicial nominees: Daniel Mack Traynor to the Eighth Circuit Court by 48-47, and Antonio M. Pozos to the Eastern District of Pennsylvania by 49-44. The chamber failed to discharge the Foreign Relations Committee from a measure on Iran hostilities removal (47-49), and began considering the Seed Act with a cloture vote scheduled for Monday at 5:30 PM.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House passed two major measures Thursday morning: H. Con. Res. 89 directing the President to remove armed forces from hostilities with Iran by 214-208, and H.R. 8884, the Removing Barriers to Work for Disabled Americans Act, by 232-188. The chamber then adjourned for a district work period from July 23 through August 30.
